test.query: SELECT count() FROM numbers_mt(1000000) AS l RIGHT JOIN (SELECT if(number % 20 = 0, NULL, number) AS key FROM numbers_mt(20000000)) AS r ON l.number = r.key
SELECT count() FROM numbers_mt(1000000) AS l FULL JOIN (SELECT if(number % 20 = 0, NULL, number) AS key FROM numbers_mt(20000000)) AS r ON l.number = r.key
SELECT count() FROM numbers_mt(1000000) AS l RIGHT JOIN numbers_mt(20000000) AS r ON l.number = r.number AND r.number % 100 != 0
SELECT count() FROM numbers_mt(1000000) AS l RIGHT JOIN (SELECT if(number % 20 = 0, NULL, number) AS key, number AS flag FROM numbers_mt(20000000)) AS r ON l.number = r.key AND r.flag % 100 != 0
